pdf.body:
<#assign poRawText = ""> <#if record.custrecord_po_number?is_sequence> <#list record.custrecord_po_number as poItem> <#assign poRawText = poRawText + (poItem.text!poItem?string) + " "> </#list> <#elseif record.custrecord_po_number?has_content> <#assign poRawText = record.custrecord_po_number?string> </#if> <#assign poRawText = poRawText?trim>
<#assign relatedPOs = []> <#if poRawText?has_content> <#list poRawText?split("(?=Purchase Order #)", "r") as poChunk> <#if poChunk?trim?has_content> <#assign relatedPOs = relatedPOs + [ poChunk?trim ]> </#if> </#list> </#if>
<#assign poDetailsByTranId = {}> <#if poDetails?? && poDetails?is_sequence> <#list poDetails as pd> <#assign poDetailsByTranId = poDetailsByTranId + { pd.tranid?string: pd }> </#list> </#if>
<#assign poCount = 0>
<#assign poList = record.custrecord_po_number?string?split("#")>
<#if companyInformation.logoUrl?has_content>
</#if> ${companyInformation.legalname}
${companyInformation.addressText}
Group Summary
Vendor ${record.custrecord_vendor.altname}
Date ${.now?string("MM/dd/yyyy")}
Version v${record.custrecord_revision_number}
PO # ${poList?size?number - 1}
Details
${record.custrecord_master_memo}
Related Purchase Orders
<#assign poDetailsJson = (record.custrecord_bpc_po_details!"")?trim> <#assign poDetails = {}> <#if poDetailsJson?has_content> <#attempt> <#assign poDetails = poDetailsJson?eval> <#recover> <#assign poDetails = {}> </#attempt> </#if>
<#assign relatedPOs = poDetails.purchaseOrders![]>
<#if relatedPOs?has_content>
# PO Number Date Memo Lines Amount
<#assign totalAmount = 0>
<#list relatedPOs as po> <#assign amount = 0> <#if po.amount?? && po.amount?has_content> <#if po.amount?is_number> <#assign amount = po.amount> <#else> <#assign amount = po.amount?replace(",", "")?number> </#if> </#if>
<#assign totalAmount = totalAmount + amount>
${po_index + 1} ${po.poNumber!""} ${po.tranDate!""} ${po.vendorMemo!""} ${po.lineCount!0} ${amount?string(",##0.00")}
</#list>
${relatedPOs?size} Purchase Order<#if relatedPOs?size gt 1>s</#if> included in this send. <#if totalAmount gt 0> - Total: ${totalAmount?string(",##0.00")} </#if>
<#else>
No related Purchase Orders found. </#if>
